- **self**: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting (5/1)

## Definitions

- [statement] Verbalized Sampling is a training-free prompt that asks the model to verbalize a probability distribution over multiple responses (e.g. 'Generate 5 jokes about coffee and their corresponding probabilities') to circumvent mode collapse. (high confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01171 · keywords: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting · also: https://github.com/CHATS-lab/verbalized-sampling

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] VS authors attribute mode collapse to typicality bias in preference data and report 1.6-2.1x creative-writing diversity over direct prompting without hurting factual accuracy or safety; results are author-reported. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-01) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01171 · keywords: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting · also: https://github.com/CHATS-lab/verbalized-sampling
- [statement] VS gains are larger for more capable models than for smaller mini/flash variants. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01171 · keywords: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting · also: https://www.alphaxiv.org/abs/2510.01171
- [statement] A reanalysis (Schaeffer et al., June 2025) finds min-p does not beat baseline samplers on quality, diversity or their trade-off once hyperparameter count is controlled, cites omitted human-eval data and inconsistent LLM-judge reporting, and notes adoption figures were unsubstantiated and removed. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13681 · keywords: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting · also: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01082

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Min-p sampling scales the truncation threshold by the top token's probability; the original paper claims better quality and diversity than top-p at high temperature and reports adoption in Hugging Face Transformers and vLLM. (medium confidence) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01082 · keywords: Diversity-restoring decoding and prompting · also: https://iclr.cc/virtual/2025/poster/30358
